notes.title: EGX Recap!

Massive thanks to everyone that had a chance to play the game at EGX! It was a great for us to get you all playing it and having feedback from everyone.

Keep an eye out on twitter (@PKTSizedHands) for dev updates.

More news soon!

notes.title: Welcome to Honeypot Espionage... and soon EGX!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce Honeypot Espionage! The multiplayer Stealth Shooter (Coming Soon!).

It has been a crazy Summer for us here at Pocket Sized Hands as most of our work has been getting ourselves set up as an Indie Game Company. And of course, we are crazy still about VR. We are always looking feedback and let us know what you want to see in the Game.

Some of our followers already know we are a small bunch of students who have branched out of Uni to create Honeypot Espionage. We have been part of an Incubator program all summer and have worked pretty hard to get the game to where it is now. No release date yet but it will be sometime 2018 before summer. 


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30688226/db99445c4e0b3fd240bac65a6de219ae1b05b689.png[/img]


If you are heading to EGX this weekend you can get a chance to play the game and see exactly what being invisible is all about.

We will be showing off in the Tranzfuser area and Rezzed East. Come have a chat with us and we would love to hear what you all think!

With Virtual Love,
Zecbmo!
